title: The Other Eye of the Liger
description: The Other Eye of the Liger — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Logan the Liger

Quest Type: Activate / Kill

Quest Description: Once again, help the Liger defeat 10 Ponderous Luchadores off MutantMania's Level 7, in the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle or Purpose-Pondering Peak. Afterward, return to Logan the Liger in the Purpose-Pondering Peak.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Logan the Liger

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Once again, help the Liger defeat 10 Ponderous Luchadores off MutantMania's Level 7, in the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle or Purpose-Pondering Peak. Afterward, return to Logan the Liger in the Purpose-Pondering Peak.

Offer:

You have studied the ways of the Liger. Now, repetition will keep your studies fresh in your mind.

Call out to the Liger once more by placing this kibble into the nearby food bowl. When the Liger appears, spend some more time observing it's nature. As before, assist it in killing 10 Ponderous Luchadores in the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle or Purpose-Pondering Peak. Return here when you are done.

By the way, the Liger can be a fickle animal, and will not always come when you wish. Expect to lure one out no more than once every 12 hours.

Turn-in:

Let me look into your eyes, to see if you continue to understand the ways of the Liger. Hm. I can see up your nose. Would you like a tissue? I'm sorry, what were we talking about again?

Objectives:

  • Call the Liger ×1
  • Defeat Ponderous Luchadores with Liger

Level range: 86–96
